purpose: Calibration dataset scaffold for the Information Gain Gate. The gate answers 'does this knowledge surface independently add something worth preserving and retrieving?' — never 'did we rewrite the prose enough?'.
rules: No arbitrary numeric similarity threshold is defined or ratified in this sprint.
No 14K classification is performed in this sprint.
Thresholds/weights are ratified only after labelled-pair calibration (DECISION_LOG).
Textual similarity is one diagnostic signal among many, never a standalone blocker and never an optimization target.

pair_record_schema.note: signals is an object keyed by the signal names above.
